edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender, recipient and amount into _transfer
transferFrom forwards sender, recipient and amount into _transfer
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spending allowance
approve delegates the allowance update to _approve
_approve writes the _allowances mapping
_transfer delegates balance accounting to _transferStandard
_transfer forwards the contract token balance to swapTokensForEth
_transfer forwards the collected ETH to sendETHToFee
_transfer reads the contract balance via balanceOf
_transfer sets _feeAddr1 as the buy/sell tax rate
_transfer sets _feeAddr2 as the team fee rate
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to skip fee handling
_transfer checks the bots blacklist mapping
_transfer compares from with uniswapV2Pair to detect sells
_transfer guards the swap with the inSwap flag
_transfer checks swapEnabled before swapping
_transfer checks cooldownEnabled before the max transaction check
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount cooldown limit
swapTokensForEth calls the state-stored uniswapV2Router
swapTokensForEth performs the external Uniswap swap call
swapTokensForEth uses lockTheSwap which toggles inSwap
sendETHToFee performs ETH transfers to the fee wallets
openTrading stores the router address in uniswapV2Router
openTrading creates and stores the uniswapV2Pair
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the contract ETH balance
openTrading approves the router for the total supply
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true
openTrading sets swapEnabled to true
openTrading sets cooldownEnabled to false
openTrading sets the initial _maxTxAmount
openTrading is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier checking _owner
manualswap forwards the contract balance to swapTokensForEth
manualsend forwards the contract ETH balance to sendETHToFee
_transferStandard obtains fee and amount values from _getValues
_transferStandard routes the team fee via _takeTeam
_transferStandard routes the reflection fee via _reflectFee
_transferStandard debits and credits the _rOwned mapping
_getValues calls _getTValues for token amounts
_getValues calls _getRValues for reflection amounts
_getValues obtains the current rate from _getRate
_getValues passes _feeAddr1 as the tax fee percentage
_getValues passes _feeAddr2 as the team fee percentage
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply for rSupply and tSupply
tokenFromReflection uses _getRate to convert reflections
balanceOf converts the reflection balance via tokenFromReflection
balanceOf reads the _rOwned mapping
_takeTeam adds reflections to the contract _rOwned balance
_takeTeam uses _getRate to convert the team fee
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by the reflection fee
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal by the token fee
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal
setCooldownEnabled toggles cooldownEnabled
setCooldownEnabled is guarded by onlyOwner checking _owner
liftMaxTx resets _maxTxAmount to the total supply
liftMaxTx is guarded by onlyOwner checking _owner
renounceOwnership clears the _owner address
msg.sender is passed as the transfer sender
msg.sender is used to reduce the caller allowance
msg.sender is passed as the approve owner
msg.sender must equal _owner for openTrading
manualswap requires msg.sender to be _feeAddrWallet1
manualsend requires msg.sender to be _feeAddrWallet1
msg.sender must equal _owner for setCooldownEnabled
msg.sender must equal _owner for liftMaxTx
msg.sender must equal _owner for renounceOwnership
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline in swapTokensForEth
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidity deadline in openTrading
the external Uniswap swap call can re-enter the transfer flow through receive()
ETH transfers to fee wallets execute external code that can re-enter _transfer

normalization_plan.reason: sender is the address argument supplied directly to transferFrom
recipient is supplied by the caller of transfer and consumed immediately
amount is passed through transfer/transferFrom into _transfer for accounting
tokenAmount is the sole argument consumed by swapTokensForEth
the ETH amount argument is immediately split and forwarded by sendETHToFee
tAmount is the transfer amount processed inside _transferStandard
tAmount is the input used by _getValues to derive fee amounts
rFee is consumed directly by _reflectFee to reduce the reflection supply
tTeam is consumed directly by _takeTeam to credit the contract balance
the boolean argument is written straight into the cooldownEnabled flag
account is the direct lookup key used by balanceOf
the local balance snapshot is computed and consumed entirely within _transfer
